determination: 3 real bugs found and fixed: api_surface.py never populated canonical_namespace for Python (only class_import, unlike the Rust branch beside it); package_manifest.py's canonical-package detection required a dot, skipping flat packages; batch_reference.py's disambiguation truncated to the last dot-segment, silently re-colliding Python's flatter namespaces sharing a leaf segment. Filed to backlog as PDFPY-NSFIX-001 (CLOSED) with a forward-looking risk note PDFPY-CNSRISK-001 (OPEN) for the next re-scout of any other already-shipped Python product.
